guides.title: 高頻寬記憶體堆疊整合：從圖像建立驗證證據
guides.titleEn: High-bandwidth-memory stack integration: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: HBM 堆疊中的熱、供電及測試路徑不同。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: HBM heat, power and test paths differ. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。去封裝後的晶粒表面；照片本身無法解析每個儲存電容的三維結構。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：HBM 堆疊中的熱、供電及測試路徑不同。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：逐層標出可測接點與資料通道。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. A decapsulated die surface; the photograph alone does not resolve the 3D geometry of every storage capacitor.
Mark this question on your own diagram: HBM heat, power and test paths differ. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Mark test-access points and data channels layer by layer. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「逐層標出可測接點與資料通道」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Mark test-access points and data channels layer by layer, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

guides.title: 高頻寬記憶體堆疊整合：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: High-bandwidth-memory stack integration: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「辨識 HBM 層級」建立判讀邊界。DRAM 堆疊、基底介面與外部加速器扮演不同角色。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Identify HBM hierarchy to define the interpretation boundary. DRAM stacks, base interfaces and external accelerators play distinct roles. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜辨識 HBM 層級：觀察焦點：畫堆疊到中介層再到邏輯晶片的路徑。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
觀察站 2｜驗證層間對準：觀察焦點：比較中心及邊緣接點的重疊。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
觀察站 3｜完成堆疊驗收：反證與驗收：觀察焦點：標明未公開設計細節與教學假設。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Identify HBM hierarchy: Observation focus: Draw stack-to-interposer-to-logic paths. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

Observation station 2 | Verify interlayer alignment: Observation focus: Compare center and edge joint overlap. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

Observation station 3 | Complete stack acceptance: challenge and acceptance: Observation focus: Label unpublished details and teaching assumptions. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「驗證層間對準」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「完成堆疊驗收：反證與驗收」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Verify interlayer alignment: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Complete stack acceptance: challenge and acceptance to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 需排除的錯判：堆疊層數加倍必定使記憶體頻寬加倍。本步先檢查「辨識 HBM 層級」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到DRAM 堆疊、基底介面與外部加速器扮演不同角色。所指出的物理限制。
需排除的錯判：堆疊層數加倍必定使記憶體頻寬加倍。本步先檢查「驗證層間對準」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到逐層誤差與翹曲可能使邊緣接點先失效。所指出的物理限制。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Misinterpretation to reject: Doubling stack height necessarily doubles memory bandwidth. First check whether evidence for identify hbm hierarchy actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: DRAM stacks, base interfaces and external accelerators play distinct roles.

Misinterpretation to reject: Doubling stack height necessarily doubles memory bandwidth. First check whether evidence for verify interlayer alignment actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Layer errors and warpage can make edge joints fail first.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.
